Extract markdown-aware chunks and pass their content and metadata to your retrieval system.

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
from xberg import extract, ExtractInput
from xberg._xberg import ExtractionConfig

async def main() -> None:
    input = ExtractInput.from_json("{\"kind\":\"uri\",\"mime_type\":\"text/markdown\",\"uri\":\"https://example.com/markdown/comprehensive.md\"}")
    config = ExtractionConfig.from_json("{\"chunking\":{\"chunker_type\":\"markdown\",\"max_characters\":500,\"overlap\":50,\"trim\":true}}")
    result = await extract(input, config)
    print(result.results[0].chunks)

asyncio.run(main())
```
